In this petition, the petitioner seeks the following relief:
"Quash the charge sheet in CC No. 4245/2022 filed by the first Respondent Tumakuru Women Police against the Petitioner herein for the alleged offences punishable under Sections 498A, 323, 504 IPC and Section 4 of Dowry Prohibition Act 1961 before the Hon'ble II Addl. Sr. Civil Judge & JMFC Court, Tumakuru."
2. After arguing the matter for some time, the learned counsel for the petitioner submits that the petition may be disposed of reserving liberty in favour of the petitioner to seek discharge/file discharge application which may be directed to be considered by the trial Court in accordance with law.
